portal_synopsis: glusterfs-3.4 native client bug fix update
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

To update all RPMs for your particular architecture, run:

rpm -Fvh [filenames]

where [filenames] is a list of the RPMs you wish to upgrade.  Only those
RPMs which are currently installed will be updated.  Those RPMs which are
not installed but included in the list will not be updated.  Note that you
can also use wildcards (*.rpm) if your current directory *only* contains the
desired RPMs.

Please note that this update is also available via Red Hat Network.  Many
people find this an easier way to apply updates.  To use Red Hat Network,
launch the Red Hat Update Agent with the following command:

up2date

This will start an interactive process that will result in the appropriate
RPMs being upgraded on your system.

portal_summary:
Updated glusterfs-3.4 native client packages that address several bugs are now
available for Red Hat Storage 2.1 via Red Hat Common.

portal_description:
Red Hat Storage is software-only, scale-out storage that provides flexible and
affordable unstructured data storage for an enterprise. GlusterFS, a key
building block of Red Hat Storage, is based on a stackable user-space design and
can deliver exceptional performance for diverse workloads. GlusterFS aggregates
various storage servers over network interconnects into one large, parallel
network file system. 

This update adds the following enhancement:

* Updated glusterfs-3.4 native client packages have been included in the Red Hat
Common channel. (BZ#1130314) 

Users of glusterfs are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
